how: PRE_REG.md frozen first (commit 00157e43c); best per cell on DEV only; VALIDATION 2024-07..2025-06 read once on picks; Holm m = 11; day-clustered 95 % CI; DEFAULT needs power PASS and fee-net CI above 0.
window: DEV 2017-08..2024-06, VALIDATION 2024-07..2025-06 (picks only), HOLDOUT never loaded; BTCUSDT+ETHUSDT SPOT klines, no futures splice

verdict.label: NO DEFAULT CHANGES. Part A (OURS bear proxy per regime/phase cell): INCONCLUSIVE (underpowered), not FAIL: the power gate (m = 11) BLOCKs every picked cell and 3 cells have no setting with n >= 30, so d-bear-proxy-1104 stays. Part B (fake-out filter per timeframe): 15m is the only powered TF and its picked filter (volume) FAILS on VALIDATION (fee-net -0.183 % [-0.312, -0.053]); 1h, 4h, 1d INCONCLUSIVE (underpowered). 0 of 11 cells earn a default; HOLDOUT never loaded.

why: Part A: 69 of 168 setting-cell rows reached n >= 30 and 20 days on DEV; none has a fee-net CI above 0. Best DEV points (range/mature +0.250 %, n 122 / 47 days; ALL +0.003 %) are the best of 24 and collapsed on VALIDATION (n 5 and n 46).

The baseline gate (weekly RSI14 <= 40, below SMA200) does nothing measurable: shorts inside -0.166 % vs outside -0.194 % (difference +0.028, t 0.48). Its 4-week lower-close hit rate is 0.376 over 109 gated weeks vs 0.423 for all weeks: low weekly RSI is followed by a bounce slightly more often than average.

Part B 15m (powered): every filter loses after cost (none -0.139, confirm1 -0.198, htf_rsi -0.207, volume -0.110, retest -0.172 %); fake-out rate stays 44-54 % in every cell, with or without a filter.
Only lead: 4h higher-TF RSI agreement (+0.203 DEV, +0.747 VALIDATION) but n 170 / 27, CIs span zero, power BLOCK. Next step is more symbols and bear years, each a new PRE_REG.
